name: Livingston of Fort Washington (11901 Gunpowder Dr / 12000 Livingston Rd) — CGO mixed-use concept

parcels.description: COR LIV RD & IND HD HWY PARCEL A

constraints.source: PGAtlas Environmental/MapServer — Stream Center and Drainage (2023) buffered 50 ft; Slope (2023) >25%; Floodplain (FEMA 2026) other than Zone X; Woodland Conservation Area (approved TCPs); Wetland (DNR). Clipped to the tract.
constraints.caveat: The Primary Management Area, the woodland conservation threshold and any expanded buffers are set by an approved Natural Resources Inventory and TCP, not by these layers. A 50-ft stream buffer and slopes over 25% are the minimum that would be taken; the NRI may take more.

stormwater.method: MDE Stormwater Design Manual Ch. 5 ESD — Rv = 0.05 + 0.009·I; ESDv = P_E·Rv·A/12; practice area = ESDv/(d·n), d = 2 ft, n = 0.4; P_E = 1.0 in is the floor — Table 5.3 raises it with % impervious and HSG
stormwater.finding: The 107,627 sf reserved (existing facility and its expansion) exceeds twice the 16,743 sf of practice the drawn programme needs at P_E 1.0 in; the balance is forebay, access, freeboard and the higher P_E the soils may require.
stormwater.additional: Micro-bioretention in every surface parking lot island and a bioswale along each private street, credited under ESD; rooftop disconnection is not available over parking. Design per the DPIE stormwater concept approval that precedes the DSP.

access.note: Every internal street tees off GUNPOWDER (existing public right-of-way); no new access to any other road.
